jd:
T-Mobile is synonymous with innovation–and you could be part of the team that disrupted an entire industry! We reinvented customer service, brought real 5G to the nation, and now we’re shaping the future of technology in wireless and beyond. Our work is as exciting as it is rewarding, so consider the career opportunity below as your invitation to grow with us, make big things happen with us, above all, #BEYOU with us. Together, we won’t stop!
 
 Get hands-on experience, training—and a leg up on a bright future.

T-Mobile didn’t become a leader by following the playbook. We got here by breaking it. We’re a disruptor that now plays on a higher tier, and we’re still raising the bar for millions of customers nationwide. If you want to work somewhere that sets the standard instead of matching it, this is your place.

This is an 11-week paid learning experience where you’ll do real work, not busywork. You’ll build relationships with other interns and leaders across the company, and you’ll be paired with mentors who will challenge you to grow skills that matter. We’ll give you hands-on projects with real stakes, and we expect your creativity and sharp ideas to make an immediate impact. You’ll work alongside T-Mobile employees who have your back and who still believe the best ideas can come from anyone. 
 
 What It’s Like 
 Our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team keeps T-Mobile’s business-critical systems reliable, available, and fast. We’re small enough that you’ll be seen and heard, and big enough that your work matters. A typical week mixes hands-on building (scripts, dashboards, alerts) with digging into system metrics and logs, joining incident investigations, and swapping ideas with SRE and engineering partners. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will push you to learn fast and own your work.

 What You’ll Do 
 You’ll help improve infrastructure monitoring, automation, and system reliability across T-Mobile’s critical services. By building dashboards, automating manual work, and analyzing system performance, you’ll help us catch issues before they reach customers and keep delivering the seamless digital experiences people expect from the Un-carrier.

 Key Responsibilities 
 
• Build and enhance monitoring dashboards, alerts, and observability solutions that proactively surface infrastructure and application issues 
• Develop Python or Bash scripts that automate repetitive operational tasks and reduce manual effort 
• Analyze system metrics, logs, and performance trends to identify reliability risks and recommend improvements 
• Support incident investigation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis, and document operational procedures 
• Partner with SRE and engineering teams on capacity planning, infrastructure performance, and continuous improvement initiatives 
 What It Takes 
 You’re curious, you challenge assumptions, and you move with urgency when something breaks. You bring a foundation in Linux/Unix, networking, and cloud computing, plus basic scripting experience in Python, Bash, or similar languages. Familiarity with AWS and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk is a plus, as are CI/CD, Git, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). You’re a sharp problem-solver and a clear communicator who takes ownership, pays attention to detail, and learns quickly. Hands-on experience from academic projects, internships, personal projects, open-source work, technical clubs, or hackathons will help you stand out. AWS Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate certifications are a plus but not required.

 Minimum Qualifications 
 
• At least 18 years of age 
• Legally authorized to work in the United States now and in the future 
• Must have one or more course(s) remaining in a Bachelors or Graduate degree program post internship 
• Employees of T-Mobile or Metro by T-Mobile are ineligible for external Summer Internships, please see Magenta Accelerator if interested 
 Relocation assistance will be provided to program participants who reside more than 50 miles from the internship location.

 Intern wages range from $27/hour to $50/hour. The successful candidate’s actual pay will be based on education/STEM vs non-STEM designation.

Never stop growing!   
As part of the T-Mobile team, you know the Un-carrier doesn’t have a corporate ladder–it’s more like a jungle gym of possibilities! We love helping our employees grow in their careers, because it’s that shared drive to aim high that drives our business and our culture forward. By applying for this career opportunity, you’re living our values while investing in your career growth–and we applaud it. You’re unstoppable!   
T-Mobile USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All decisions concerning the employment relationship will be made without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, religious affiliation, marital status, citizenship status, veteran status, the presence of any physical or mental disability, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Discrimination, retaliation or harassment based upon any of these factors is wholly inconsistent with how we do business and will not be tolerated.   
Talent comes in all forms at the Un-carrier. If you are an individual with a disability and need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know by emailing ApplicantAccommodation@t-mobile.com or calling 1-844-873-9500. Please note, this contact channel is not a means to apply for or inquire about a position and we are unable to respond to non-accommodation related requests.
fit_why: SRE role: Linux, cloud, observability gaps; strong Python/Docker overlap

A typical week mixes building features in a modern greenfield codebase, pairing with experienced engineers, getting code reviews, and testing on real devices in our lab. You’ll work with engineers, product partners, and designers, and your ideas will be heard.

 What You’ll Do 
 You’ll help build the next generation of media playback technology behind T-Mobile’s advertising ecosystem. Our cross-platform player delivers consistent, high-performance playback on Android, Linux, and Windows devices in real-world public environments. You’ll implement new features and port functionality from a legacy system, which speeds up time-to-market for a platform used across customer-managed deployments and helps T-Mobile stay ahead.

 Key Responsibilities 
 
• Design, implement, test, and debug features in a greenfield codebase using Kotlin Multiplatform 
• Port functionality from the legacy player to the new cross-platform architecture 
• Test and validate software across a wide range of hardware configurations in our lab to ensure reliability and performance 
• Collaborate with engineers, product partners, and designers on performance, reliability, and usability 
• Contribute to standups, planning, and retrospectives 
• Participate in code reviews and follow best practices for quality and maintainability 
 What It Takes 
 
• Familiarity with Kotlin or Android development, or a strong interest in learning both 
• Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., Kotlin, Java, TypeScript) 
• Understanding of software development fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms 
• Exposure to version control systems such as Git 
• Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the drive to learn and move with urgency in a fast-paced environment 
• A habit of challenging assumptions and working well with others 
• Plus: interest in or exposure to distributed systems, IoT, or cross-platform development. Experience with large connected systems is a big differentiator that speeds up onboarding.

jd:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. 

 Join NVIDIA’s AI Clouds team to build software and automation that help our teams support cloud partners and advance AI infrastructure programs. Working with a technical mentor and business partners, you’ll take a focused project from an initial problem statement to a working tool or feature. You’ll gain experience using AI-assisted development tools, gathering user feedback, and measuring how your work improves everyday workflows.

 What you’ll be doing: 
 
• Build and deliver a scoped software tool or automation feature using AI-assisted development tools, with guidance from your technical mentor. 
• Work with partners across sales, marketing, strategy and operations, program management, and solutions architecture to understand manual workflows and define project requirements. 
• Test, debug, and refine your work, following the team’s practices for code review, data handling, and deployment. 
• Analyze usage and user feedback to understand adoption, identify improvements, and help scope future projects. 
• Create documentation and quick-start guides that help colleagues adopt and use the tools you build. 
 What we need to see: 
 
• Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or an equivalent program area. 
• Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript through coursework, personal projects, or previous internships. 
• Experience building a software application, automation script, or data project, with the ability to explain your approach and technical decisions. 
• Familiarity with APIs, structured data, and Git or another version-control system. 
• Experience testing and debugging code, including checking the correctness of AI-generated outputs. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 
• Projects using AI coding assistants, large language models, or workflow automation. 
• Experience creating dashboards, analyzing product usage, or connecting data from multiple sources. 
• Interest in cloud computing and AI infrastructure, with curiosity about how software can improve business operations. 
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! 

 You will also be eligible for Intern   benefits . ​ 

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 14, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
 
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
fit_why: Python/JS/TypeScript, APIs, Git, AI tooling; strong full-stack intern match
